scope: Maritime article layout, authorship, visible passage footnotes; lightweight downloadable reading with short source list
Shared editorial process page, About and footer link
Sequential route inventory, reusable components and CI delivery-evidence guard
Shared downloaded-book credit links to the editorial process; original photographer credits and personal-note controls preserved.

checks.desktop: 1280px visual check: reference reading column, natural line length, uncropped photography
checks.mobile: 390px visual check: readable source notes, byline and heading, no horizontal overflow
checks.keyboard: Enter on source return link returns focus to the exact in-text reference
checks.media: Existing museum photographs retain 2013 dates, interpretation context, creators and licences; no new generated images
checks.provenance: Internal inspection notes remain in KB. Website has concise reader_note footnotes. Downloads retain source titles/links and omit detailed notes under the Founder clarification.

limitations: Same-assistant review, not independent human or specialist review.
This is an editorial presentation revision using the existing reviewed research, not a new historical research investigation. Existing substantive uncertainties remain in the narrative.
Responsive browser checks are not physical-device or screen-reader testing.
Remaining routes require individual classification and article review; no bulk claim of completion.
No substantive 500-item count increment for formatting or policy work.
